history: PR #2126 reported 24 tier-1 keys; the full union read 46 on its base and 60 at e8245e1d8b, when UX-UG-ES-USTED-TIER1-REMAINING-20260919 swept them (#3055). This inventory is re-measured after that sweep and after the casework/admin imperatives joined tests/i18nRegisterMarkers.js FORMAL_IMPERATIVES. Tier 2 was 80 keys (25 reader / 55 third) at e8245e1d8b in closed #2620's triage; admin.command.directorySub has since left it, workspace.overviewHelp moved up to tier 1 (its 'Elija' is now a marker), and 18 keys arrived, mostly access-history copy moved into the catalogue. UX-UG-ES-USTED-TIER2-READER-ADDRESSED-20260919 then moved 27 of the 35 reader-addressed keys to tú: 25 left tier 2, and the two mixed keys (procedure.settingsHelp, inbox.redacted.retention_expired) keep a third-person su/sus and moved to third_person. The 8 legal.* keys stay reader-addressed: every legal.* line feeds LEGAL_COPY_FINGERPRINT, so their register change belongs to a legal review. Later, with the dues copy (Union Ground leaves dues out; owner decision, 2026-10-15), dues.stripeNotConnectedNote left tier 1 and dues.reminderDelivery left the tier-2 third-person class.

notes.tasks.deleteNotifies: third-person: EN '{name} is notified that it left their list' — the named person's list, not the reader's.
notes.automation.pages.historicalSelectedSourc: third-person: EN 'the selected source in its authorized chapter' — the source's chapter, not the reader's.
notes.legal.aiDisclosure.route.body: reader-addressed: 'su agencia' is the reader's agency.
notes.legal.aiDisclosure.connector.body: mixed/reader-addressed: EN ends in 'your identity'; ES 'su identidad' addresses the reader. Earlier su/sus in the same string are the agency's. Binary key-level schema places mixed strings in the repair set.
notes.settings.sessionRevokeWarning: third-person: 'su sesión' is the selected device's server session.
notes.steward.scanSub: third-person: 'su teléfono' is the member's phone in 'código de un miembro desde su teléfono'.
notes.inbox.redacted.retention_expired: third-person after the reader-addressed repair: 'tu organización' now addresses the reader in tú; 'su texto' is the message's text.
notes.legal.privacy.ai.body: third-person: 'su propio conector' / 'sus condiciones' belong to the agency's connector.
notes.settings.visibilityBody: third-person: 'su función' is authorized staff's role; the reader is already tú in the same string.
notes.admin.retention.refused.executionFailed: third-person: EN 'failed during execution'; ES 'durante su proceso' is the retention run's own execution, not the reader's.
notes.rpcError.event_has_attendance: third-person: 'en su lugar' is the fixed adverbial for EN 'instead'. The su possesses nothing and addresses nobody; the rest of the string is already tú ('Cancélalo').
notes.civic.unavailable: reader-addressed: EN 'find your officials'; the same string also carries the usted imperative 'Inicie sesión', which no marker list names yet.
notes.accessHistory.updateRecordFailed: third-person: EN 'its access-history entry' is the case's entry; the reader is already tú ('Inténtalo').
notes.admin.chapterLifecycle.noChapter: third-person: EN 'its partnerships' belong to the chapter.
notes.admin.retention.sub: third-person: EN 'their durable history' belongs to the deletion jobs.
notes.admin.retention.cause.execution_failed: third-person: 'durante su proceso' is the run's own execution (same as admin.retention.refused.executionFailed).
notes.coordination.coalitionVoteGoverned: third-person: 'por su cuenta' is the organization acting on its own.
notes.coordination.noticeExportReady: third-person: 'para su descarga autorizada' is the export's download; EN 'ready for authorized download'.
notes.procedure.settingsHelp: third-person after the reader-addressed repair: 'Tu organización' now addresses the reader in tú; 'sus propios pasos' are the organization's steps.
